lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Are you finding your way from the station?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Yes, I am discovering Paris on foot.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Follow the canal for a quieter start; the city changes pace beside the water.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: That sounds better than rushing straight to the famous view.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There is time for the market, a café, and the river before evening.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Merci, Camille. I will let the streets lead me there.

lines.text: Merci, Camille. I will let the streets lead me there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take a look at the peaches before they sell out.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: They smell like the end of summer. Merci!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nobody rushes a coffee here. Sit for a minute if you can.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: A minute is exactly what my feet wanted.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Stop halfway across the footbridge. The water looks best from the middle.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Then I will stop halfway. Thank you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The green bookstalls along the quay are worth a slow look.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Then I will walk slowly and look twice.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: After dark the tower sparkles for a few minutes every hour.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Then I have a good reason to come back tonight.
